sentences: In June 1889, Van Gogh painted this while staying at the asylum in Saint-Rémy in southern France.
He watched the pre-dawn sky from his window, but he painted the picture by day in his studio, blending memory and imagination.
The village and church spire were not in his view at all, and the spire looks more like a church from his native Netherlands.
The swirls in the sky keep the texture of thickly applied paint, so the whole surface seems to move.
On the left, a cypress shoots up like a flame, linking earth to sky.
Van Gogh himself considered it a failure, yet it has become the best-loved night sky in the world.
